description: ABOUT QUALIFYCODE AI has made it trivial to fabricate resumes, take-home assignments, and remote interviews. QualifyCode is the integrity layer for technical hiring—helping engineering teams verify candidate work objectively while keeping every hiring decision explainable, auditable, and fair. We are a small, product-focused team in Mumbai running a live production platform used in real hiring workflows. Our product spans a proctored web coding IDE, a recruiter decision console, isolated code-execution pipelines, and automated integrity and code-quality analysis services. Everything is built and owned in-house, end to end. THE ROLE We’re looking for a Software Engineer to work across the full stack rather than a single siloed layer. Our system combines event-driven workflows, service-to-service APIs, and real-time client communication—so your work will span React interfaces, TypeScript and Python backend services, PostgreSQL data models, and asynchronous job queues. At this stage of our growth, the core engineering focus is scale, reliability, and hardening—driving down end-to-end latency, optimizing database queries, refining access controls, and strengthening distributed concurrency. This role fits someone who reads how a production system actually behaves before changing it, and who ships verified fixes over quick guesses. WHAT YOU’LL OWN • Candidate Coding Experience: Build and harden our browser-based IDE—editing workflows, resilient autosave, live execution feedback over WebSockets, pre-assessment environment checks, and reliable media uploads. • Recruiter Decision Console: Develop the dashboard hiring managers rely on under time pressure—candidate reports, code-quality and integrity breakdowns, session timelines, review queues, and synchronized media playback. • Core Backend & Orchestration: Design and scale APIs and state machines handling assessment lifecycles, candidate sessions, RBAC, usage accounting, and asynchronous workflows with clean contracts and idempotent failure handling. • Analysis & Scoring Pipelines: Extend our code-quality and integrity pipelines across deterministic scoring rules, telemetry processing, computer-vision signals, and bounded LLM integrations—keeping results accurate and explainable. • Reliability & Observability: Improve resilience across execution sandboxes, PostgreSQL databases, Redis queues, and object storage. Debug issues with distributed traces and metrics, and back every fix with regression tests. OUR STACK You don't need prior fluency in every tool, but you should be strong in TypeScript and comfortable moving across frontend state, backend APIs, SQL query plans, and Python services: • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query, Monaco Editor, Socket.IO, browser media/WASM APIs • Backend: Node.js (NestJS, Prisma, Express), Python (FastAPI) • Data & Async: PostgreSQL, Redis, S3-compatible object storage, BullMQ, Celery, Server-Sent Events • Infra & Observability: Docker, Linux, GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, k6 WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR • 1–4 years of production experience shipping full-stack web applications (or equivalent demonstrated depth). • Strong TypeScript & React fundamentals—able to reason across UI state, API lifecycles, and relational schemas in the same afternoon. • Solid backend engineering: Practical grasp of HTTP semantics, auth/RBAC, idempotency, transactions, and fault-tolerant queue retries. • PostgreSQL beyond CRUD: Comfortable with joins, indexing, migrations, and reading EXPLAIN plans. • High engineering rigor: You verify changes with tests, traces, or benchmarks before calling them done. • Immediate availability to join our Mumbai office (Hybrid). Bonus points for: A live project or readable GitHub repo with real users; experience debugging distributed race conditions or retry storms; production LLM or media/computer-vision integrations; Python async services (FastAPI/Celery); or work in audited domains like HR tech or fintech. HOW WE ENGINEER • Contract-first APIs: Shared schemas, pagination standards, and permission models are strictly typed across services. • Verification by default: Bug fixes ship with regression tests; auth changes include negative (403) tests; performance work includes measurements. • Zero-downtime evolution: Database and API changes roll out via staged, backward-compatible migrations. • Safe rollouts & CI guardrails: Feature flags, shadow-mode validation for automated scoring, and automated CI checks for timeouts and bounded queries. HOW TO APPLY Please apply at https://qualifycode.com/careers (and include the following in your application or Wellfound note): 1. A working link to something you built (a live product, open-source contribution, or GitHub repo we can read). 2. One line on which part of our stack or problem space you’d most want to own.

Models that can reason over a design, run the physics and check their own work will change that, and the stack that makes it possible is being built now. **About Faraday Loop** We build AI for physical engineering. We work at the point where learned models, physics simulation and real engineering design meet, with real design teams, on problems where the answer has to hold up against physics. We are backed by Founders, Inc. and are part of NVIDIA Inception. **About the role** You'd be one of the first engineers, and you'd shape what we build as much as how. We need physics, electrical engineering and machine learning in some combination. Nobody has all three at depth; we expect real depth in one, working fluency in a second, and curiosity about the third. **What you'll do** - Build and validate simulation and modelling systems, and check them against references and measurement. - Train models on physics, and design the evaluations that show where they can and can't be trusted. - Build agents that do real engineering work and verify their own results. - Work directly with engineers at design partners on their real problems. - Own a problem end to end, from the physics to the thing a customer runs. **You should have** - Deep, hands-on experience in at least one of: computational physics or numerical simulation; electrical engineering design (RF, signal or power integrity, analog, packaging); machine learning for physical systems. - Working fluency in a second of those. - A track record of taking something from idea to a working result that someone else used. - Strong Python, and the habit of checking a result against a second method before believing it. - Comfort with an early company: ambiguous problems, few people, direct customer contact. **Nice to have** - You've written, contributed to or validated a solver. - Experience training models on simulation data. - HPC or GPU experience, or numerical linear algebra. - A PhD or equivalent research experience, publications, or open-source scientific software. - Experience building LLM agents with tools and verification. **How to apply** Apply here with your CV or LinkedIn, and a link to or description of one thing you built. description: Build AI agents that do real finance work, where being right is everything. ### The role Every finance team runs on a mountain of manual work that no software ever covered: reconciliations, payouts, reporting, chasing numbers across systems. Finance teams are already among the most enthusiastic builders on Isomorph. Now we are building a finance platform on top of it, with ready-made agents and apps that make that work run itself. You will be its founding engineer. You will build with real finance teams, ship agents that move real money correctly, and turn what works into products many companies use. ### What you’ll own - Finance agents and apps that teams adopt in days and trust completely. - Deep connections into the accounting, banking and payment systems finance runs on. - The building blocks that let a finance team’s own AI agent build software an auditor would sign off on. - Making accuracy and control the reason people choose us. ### What you’ll get to build next - Build a deep understanding of finance work, from matching messy records to reading financial documents, that in time leads to finance-specific models of our own. - Build toward a month-end close that largely runs itself. ### You’ll thrive here if - You have built software for finance, payments, accounting or fintech, and you know why accuracy matters. - You have shipped AI agents where “mostly right” was not good enough. - You have tamed messy external systems and made them reliable. - You enjoy sitting with finance teams and seeing your work change their month. ### Why Isomorph For fifty years, software inside a company has been written by a small group of engineers, for everyone else. That is ending. With AI, the people who know the work best (the finance analyst, the ops lead, the recruiter, the support manager) can now build the software they need themselves. Most of them have never written a line of code. This is one of the biggest shifts in how companies work, and it has a missing piece. The software these people build is useful, and very often unsafe: no sign-in, sensitive data exposed, nobody to run it, and invisible to IT. Multiply that across a large company and you get thousands of apps and agents that nobody governs. **Isomorph is the foundation that software runs on.** Bring an app or agent built with any AI tool, and Isomorph runs it on the company’s own cloud: secured, connected to company data and systems, monitored and kept healthy. Builders never think about infrastructure. IT stays in control of everything. We believe every company will become AI-native one workflow at a time, built by its own people. Isomorph is where that software will live. **The team.** You will join a small, high-talent-density founding team from IIT Madras and IIT Delhi. The founders are second-time founders who have built companies before and sold one. ### Why you’ll love it here - **You’ll be early.** You will be one of the first people on the team, with real ownership and a real say in what Isomorph becomes. - **You’ll work at the frontier.** AI agents and enterprise-grade infrastructure, applied to a problem every company is about to have. - **You’ll see your impact.** We work side by side with customers, so what you ship is in real people’s hands within days. - **You’ll build the way the future builds.** We build Isomorph with AI agents ourselves, so your leverage is your judgment and your taste, not your typing speed. - **You’ll grow fast.** Small team, huge surface, founders who have built and scaled before.
